disclosure: Industry news: GoHighLevel Field Services private beta, launched Nov 3, 2026

claims.text: GoHighLevel launched a private beta called Field Services on November 3, 2026, combining quotes, scheduling, dispatch, invoicing and payment for HVAC, plumbing, electrical, cleaning and landscaping businesses.
Black Arrow's platform already unifies CRM, booking, two-way texting and revenue reporting in one system, with a 14-day free trial and no card required.
The average job in a home-service business passes through four or five separate tools, and each handoff is a point where a lead can go quiet.
